messages:
rachel: Kicking off prod rollout for release v2.14.3 now (change window open). watching SLOs closely. deploy-bot: preflight checks passed for service=embed, traffic=10% canary. rachel: tx -- canary will ramp to 25% at +10m if no alerts. kevin: I'll keep an eye on p95 and 5xx, linking dash: https://dashboards.internal/redwood/embed/slo (refresh every 15s). jamal: runbook link: https://wiki/redwood/deploys/runbook#embed -> steps for partial pin / rollback. sre-bot: alert -> p95 latency spike on eu-west: 920ms (threshold 600ms) for canary pods at 2026-03-20T04:03:12Z. kevin: seeing the same, errors ticking up from 0.2% -> 1.5% on embedding requests. tagging @rachel. rachel: hold ramp. do not push to 25%. ops-ally: checked infra -- no autoscaler flapping, GPU utilization steady. jamal: past deploys show similar latency jump when kv-cache cold. canary should warm KV cache; but error rate increase is concerning. kevin: checking logs, sample trace: ```
ERROR [embed] request_id=abcd1234 status=502 upstream_timeout
stack: client.call -> model.infer -> grpc timeout
``` rachel: let's pin traffic back to previous stable (v2.14.2) for production while we triage. jamal: how fast can we pin? deploy-bot: executing traffic pin -> service=embed target_version=v2.14.2 traffic=100%. progress: 8% -> 40% -> 100%. sre-bot: followup alert cleared for p95 after pin; current p95 410ms, 5xx back to 0.15%. kevin: confirmed. no more errors after fallback. rachel: good call. create ticket for postmortem and follow-up action items: investigate KV cache warm, add smoke warmup step in preflight. jamal: adding to release notes: "rollback: v2.14.3 rolled back to v2.14.2 due to p95 latency spike in eu-west; follow-up: kv-cache warmup and timeout tuning." kevin: re-run canary with warmup and reduced concurrency once fix in branch. rachel: thanks all. closing window early. deploy-bot: release status: rolled back, deploy window closed. :white_check_mark:
